name: inkwell
description: Inkwell — a Medium-inspired publishing MVP (Next.js + Express + MongoDB)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "pnpm --filter server dev" "pnpm --filter client dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter server build && pnpm --filter client build
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "pnpm --filter server start" "pnpm --filter client start"
